content:
rachel: pushed a micro mock for compact p95 rows with a tiny sampler pill and an optional heat-spark thumbnail. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/compact-p95-sampler

omar: quick a11y check: if the pill is interactive it needs keyboard focus, a visible focus ring, and an aria-label like "Trace sampling, 10 percent". NVDA should announce the value when it changes.

devon: perf heads-up: inline interactive controls will cause row reflows when expanding. prefer a zero-height-change popover anchored to the pill, or move the control to row actions. virtualization will stutter if many rows remeasure.

kate: copy suggestions: label the pill "Sampling: 10%" (helps scan). tooltip: "Limit returned traces to reduce cost and noise." Also ensure pill color meets 3:1 at 12px. add a small hatch pattern for high-density heat buckets (don't rely on color only).

omar: keyboard pattern: Enter opens popover, arrows navigate presets (Off, 1%, 5%, 10%, 25%, 100%), Esc closes. Consider +/- shortcuts but gated behind a help modal to avoid collisions.

rachel: thanks, all. i'll update with three variants: inline read-only summary + popover, inline editable (range with aria updates), and popover-only in the actions menu. will include the aria copy and perf notes.

design-bot: Reminder: design review tomorrow <2034441600> 11:00am PT. Agenda: compact rows, sampler discoverability, keyboard patterns.

devon: i'll run a microbenchmark for reflow cost per 2k rows and paste numbers before the review.

rachel: great, thanks :thumbsup:
